So the next time someone tells you that you can only use your keyword a certain number of times, completely ignore it.

Remember when Datarag was just another AI research wrapper? Yeah, we don't talk about that anymore. 🫣

Here's what happened: We were building fancy AI research tools, and then we realized... we kept losing the articles we were researching. We'd read something brilliant on Tuesday, need it on Thursday, and spend 20 minutes searching trying to find it again.

So we stopped. Deleted a bunch of code. And built what we actually needed.

👉 Introducing the New Datarag: Your Browser's Memory Upgrade

Now Datarag does one simple thing obsessively well: it remembers everything you read online so you never have to find it twice.

That article about fermentation? Saved.
That YouTube tutorial? Indexed.
What Sarah said in the 3pm Google Meet? Transcribed and searchable.

All of it. Searchable. AI-powered. PIN-encrypted (because your browsing history is nobody's business but yours).

What Changed:
- ❌ Generic AI research tool nobody asked for
- ✅ Your personal "I swear I read this somewhere" solver

What Stayed the Same:
- Still free to try
- Still works across all your devices
- Still built by people who actually use it every day

The internet gave you infinite information. We're giving you infinite recall.
